nodes.label: Strict Layered Monolith (controllers -> service -> repository/storage)
nodes.rationale: Clear separation of responsibilities; each package has a README with mandatory rules

nodes.label: Stateless JWT Auth (role/habilitado re-read from DB)
nodes.rationale: Token only identifies the user; role and habilitado are re-read every request so disabling an account takes effect immediately
nodes.norm_label: stateless jwt auth (role/habilitado re-read from db)

nodes.label: Role Hierarchy SUPERADMINISTRADOR > ADMINISTRADOR
nodes.rationale: hasRole('ADMINISTRADOR') also admits superadmins via RoleHierarchy

nodes.label: Store Object Key (fotoClave), Not URL
nodes.rationale: Public URL built from app.storage.url-publica at mapping time so switching storage provider (RustFS/R2) needs no data migration

nodes.label: Normalized Error Responses via GlobalExceptionHandler
nodes.rationale: Throw custom exceptions instead of building error responses in controllers; Spring Security 401/403 routed through same handler via HandlerExceptionResolver so all errors share one format

nodes.label: Env Vars -> application.yaml app.* -> @ConfigurationProperties records
nodes.rationale: When adding a variable update application.yaml, .env.example and docker-compose api service env

nodes.label: Integration Tests with Testcontainers (PostgreSQL + RustFS)
nodes.rationale: One shared Spring context and container set across test classes; Docker must be running

nodes.label: OrquideaBackendApplication
nodes.rationale: Excludes UserDetailsServiceAutoConfiguration because auth is JWT and the default in-memory user is unwanted; @ConfigurationPropertiesScan binds app.* records

nodes.label: Humedal La Orquidea Environmental Education Platform
nodes.rationale: Biological info collected by the committee and Universidad del Cauca volunteers is scattered; platform centralizes and publishes it so the committee can manage content without programming
nodes.norm_label: humedal la orquidea environmental education platform

nodes.label: Strict Development Rules (DwC, JPA, layers, errors, OpenAPI, Lombok, secrets)
nodes.norm_label: strict development rules (dwc, jpa, layers, errors, openapi, lombok, secrets)

nodes.label: Flyway Schema Versioning (ddl-auto validate)
nodes.rationale: Never edit an applied migration; changes go into a new one; Hibernate only validates

nodes.label: Config Layer
nodes.rationale: Only configuration and factories, no business logic

nodes.label: Controllers Layer
nodes.rationale: Thin controllers: orchestration and DTO conversion, no business logic

nodes.label: Exception Layer
nodes.rationale: Global handler mandatory for uniform responses and traceability

nodes.label: Repository Layer (Spring Data JPA)
nodes.rationale: No ad-hoc SQL outside repositories; persistence encapsulated

nodes.label: app.cors config
nodes.rationale: Allows any local port so frontend port changes need no reconfiguration

nodes.label: Multipart upload limits (10MB image / 12MB request)
nodes.rationale: Tomcat max-swallow-size 20MB lets oversized uploads be rejected with 413 instead of cutting the connection

nodes.label: fichas_taxonomicas table (V2)
nodes.rationale: Unique index on lower(nombre_cientifico) = one record per species case-insensitive; index on categoria for public listing (HU-10)

nodes.label: V3 split nombre/apellido
nodes.rationale: HU-2 registration requires separate first and last name

nodes.label: V4 drop telefono
nodes.rationale: HU-2 registration does not request phone

nodes.label: OpenApiConfig
nodes.rationale: All endpoints require JWT by default; public endpoints override it with an empty @SecurityRequirements.

nodes.label: StorageConfig
nodes.rationale: Path-style addressing works the same on Cloudflare R2 and RustFS; checksums only WHEN_REQUIRED because R2 does not support all checksums the AWS SDK sends by default.

nodes.label: AdministratorController
nodes.rationale: /api/administradores, restricted to SUPERADMINISTRADOR (HU-5, HU-4). Note: error responses document schema ApiResponse.class instead of ApiErrorResponse.class, unlike other controllers.

nodes.label: AdministratorController.revocarAcceso()
nodes.rationale: Downgrades the account to USUARIO_REGISTRADO and emails the affected user; cannot revoke the only superadministrator.

nodes.label: AuthController
nodes.rationale: /api/autenticacion: login, current session user and public registration (HU-1).

nodes.label: TaxonController
nodes.rationale: /api/fichas-taxonomicas: create/edit restricted to ADMINISTRADOR via multipart; get and list are public (HU-7, HU-8, HU-10).

nodes.label: TaxonController.actualizar()
nodes.rationale: Photo optional on edit; if absent the current one is kept.

nodes.label: TaxonController.listar()
nodes.rationale: Optional categoria filter (AVE, PLANTA, INSECTO); empty list when the category has no records.

nodes.label: AdministratorUpdateRequest
nodes.rationale: HU-5 scenario 1: replaces editable admin data; habilitado=false disables login.

nodes.label: LoginRequest
nodes.rationale: No @Email on purpose: a malformed email is answered as incorrect credentials (HU-1, scenario 2).

nodes.label: TaxonDto
nodes.rationale: Published taxonomic record using Darwin Core (DwC) naming for taxonomy fields.

nodes.label: TaxonRequest
nodes.rationale: Multipart form for create (HU-7) or edit (HU-8); photo is required only in OnCreate validation group.

nodes.label: TaxonRequest.OnCreate
nodes.rationale: Validation group for rules applying only on create (HU-7); on edit (HU-8) the photo is optional.

nodes.label: GlobalExceptionHandler.manejarValidacion()
nodes.rationale: Prioritizes annotation messages (@NotBlank, @Size) over Spring's English conversion errors; builds own message with field name for binding failures.

nodes.label: GlobalExceptionHandler.manejarParametroInvalido()
nodes.rationale: Non-UUID path id is treated as a missing resource (404); invalid query param value (e.g. categoria=PEZ) is a bad request (400).

nodes.label: GlobalExceptionHandler.manejarIntegridad()
nodes.rationale: Backstop for duplicate validations when two concurrent requests race past existence checks; returns 409.

nodes.label: GlobalExceptionHandler.manejarSubidaDemasiadoGrande()
nodes.rationale: File exceeds spring.servlet.multipart.max-file-size before reaching the controller; message uses configured max image size.

nodes.label: GlobalExceptionHandler.manejarGeneral()
nodes.rationale: Spring MVC ErrorResponse exceptions keep their status code; anything else is logged and returned as 500.

nodes.label: InvalidCredentialsException
nodes.rationale: Same response for unknown email, wrong password or disabled account so as not to reveal which emails are registered.

nodes.label: InvalidImageFormatException
nodes.rationale: HU-7 scenario 3: photo is neither jpg nor png.

nodes.label: InvalidRequestException
nodes.rationale: Input errors not expressible with validation annotations; maps to 400.

nodes.label: AdministratorMapper.actualizar()
nodes.rationale: Email is set by the service (normalized); role and password are not editable through this mapping.

nodes.label: TaxonMapper.actualizar()
nodes.rationale: Copies editable data onto the existing record; photo handled by the service.

nodes.label: TaxonMapper.aDto()
nodes.rationale: Photo URL depends on the storage backend, so it is passed in separately.

nodes.label: Taxon
nodes.rationale: Wetland species record (table fichas_taxonomicas); taxonomic fields follow Darwin Core terms; photo stored as object key (R2/S3) with public URL built on read; timestamps truncated to microseconds to match PostgreSQL.

nodes.label: User
nodes.rationale: Users table; email always stored lowercase and trimmed; enabled by default.

nodes.label: TaxonRepository
nodes.rationale: existsByNombreCientificoIgnoreCaseAndIdNot: on edit, a name only clashes if used by a different record.

nodes.label: SecurityConfig.jerarquiaRoles()
nodes.rationale: HU-6: SUPERADMINISTRADOR inherits all ADMINISTRADOR permissions, so @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMINISTRADOR')") suffices.

nodes.label: EmailNotificationService
nodes.rationale: Mail send failures are logged but do not undo the business operation.

nodes.label: ImageType
nodes.rationale: HU-7 accepts jpg/png, detected by byte signature (magic bytes), not by extension or client Content-Type.
